text:
olivia: Thanks for joining the all-hands — starting a follow-up thread for security/privacy/compliance questions (SOC2/ISO, VPC, audit logs, KMS). Panel: @mari (Head of Security), @raj (CTO), @jeff (Product). Drop Qs and we'll answer live + follow up. :lock:

sam: Quick Q — SOC2: what's the target for Type II completion? :question:

mari: We finished control remediation in July. Auditor window planned for Sept 1–Nov 30; expecting final Type II report in Q4 (likely late Oct). Still finalizing auditor dates. The scope will cover Hosted + Dedicated.

sam: Will Dedicated customers be covered by the same SOC2 scope?

mari: Yes — Redwood-managed Dedicated clusters are in scope. Private (customer-managed) deployments are handled via a separate attestation path; we provide SOC2-compatible documentation and a cooperation checklist for customers to collect evidence.

olivia: What about ISO 27001 — is that next?

raj: ISO 27001 is on the roadmap for H1 next year. Plan is to leverage our SOC2 control mappings to speed the ISO program. No firm auditor booked yet, but program kickoff next quarter.

jeff: VPC/private deployment question: can customers bring their own KMS inside their VPC, or do we require Redwood-managed keys?

mari: We support three patterns: 1) Redwood-managed KMS (default), 2) Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) via cross-account AWS KMS or equivalent, and 3) HSM-based keys for on-prem packages. Customer KMS works with key policies we provide; we also support envelope encryption.

sam: Can you paste an example cross-account KMS policy snippet?

mari: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCLOUD_ACCOUNT:role/Redwood-KMS-Decrypt" },
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

olivia: Audit logs — what's the default retention across Hosted / Dedicated / Private?

mari: Hosted: 365 days default (extendable as a paid option). Dedicated: 365 days included, with long-term retention add-ons. Private/on-prem: retention is customer-controlled; we provide export hooks to S3/ELK and recommended retention guidance (>=365 days for regulated workloads).

sara: Are exported logs structured to include request_id and token counts for cost / forensics?

jeff: Yes — logs include request_id, model, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, latency_ms, route, and decision_reason for fallbacks. We also provide optional redaction and PII filters before export. Schema/ndjson examples are in the docs.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 evidence upload deadline for owners is 2025-09-15. Please tick off your controls. :rotating_light:

raj: Follow-up action: we'll publish a "security pack" artifact next Tuesday with control mappings, KMS guidance, VPC checklist, and the audit-log schema. Placeholder link: https://go/re/secure-pack (will update when published).

sam: Great — who should I ping for Dedicated/KMS integration questions?
mari: Ping @mari or @jeff. Also please open an infra ticket in #eng-infra with the tag "dedicated-kms" so we can track it.

olivia: Thanks all. We'll capture Qs in Confluence and schedule follow-ups for any customer-specific asks. If you have pressing customer items, DM the account lead and cc security. :thumbsup:
